question: Which NFA variant retained the most capacity after 100 cycles at C/3, what are its aluminium and iron contents, and what c lattice parameter does Table 1 give for it?
expect: NFA-A (LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2: 15% Al, 5% Fe), ~80% (p10.L49); Table 1 'Al-rich NFA' c = 14.2232(4)
rendered:
According to the text, the NFA variant that retained the most capacity after 100 cycles at C/3 was the NFA-A variant. 

The NFA-A variant has an aluminium content of 15% and an iron content of 5%. 

Table 1 gives the c lattice parameter for the NFA 811 variant as 14.227(3).

source.file: Advanced Materials - 2020 - Muralidharan - Lithium Iron Aluminum Nickelate  LiNixFeyAlzO2 New Sustainable Cathodes for.pdf
